character.description: The same young adult male anime protagonist: warm chestnut hair in a high ponytail, ice-blue eyes, a calm, observant face; a poised performer and expressive storyteller, wearing a sharply recognizable performance outfit with a clean silhouette and restrained decorative details with party red accents. Keep this exact face, hair, eyes, body proportions, and signature outfit in every scene.
consistency_rules: Use this exact protagonist identity in every scene; do not redesign, replace, or randomly reinterpret the character.
Preserve the same face, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, age impression, and body proportions.
Keep the signature outfit silhouette, defining accessories, and main color accents consistent across the entire music video.
Do not introduce another protagonist unless the lyrics or scene explicitly require one.

visual_language.action_style: expressive, readable full-body gestures; natural movement; clear pose silhouettes; avoid static repeated poses
visual_language.environment_style: rich anime background design rooted in plaza filled with streamers, rooftop party with string lights, street parade of balloons; preserve the theme's distinctive world and recognizable environmental details
visual_language.lighting_style: cinematic lighting harmonized with confetti pink, sunny yellow, sky blue, mint; coherent light direction, atmospheric depth, and controlled highlights
visual_language.composition_style: varied cinematic framing informed by dynamic upward shot through falling confetti, wide shot of a celebration plaza, slow-motion close-up of popping balloons; clear subject separation and intentional negative space
